sources.title: Afghanistan
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs, Austria
sources.officialityEvidence: BMEIA's live country guidance gives Austria's current advice for Austrian travellers, but does not establish a usable ordinary-passport visitor issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vor Reisen nach Afghanistan wird gewarnt.

sources.title: Bangladesh
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs, Austria
sources.officialityEvidence: BMEIA's current page distinguishes limited arrival issuance from applications at a competent mission, without tying either path to ordinary Austrian tourism.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Die Visa-Ausstellung bei der Einreise ist nur für bestimmte Reisezwecke möglich.

sources.title: Guinea-Bissau
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs, Austria
sources.officialityEvidence: BMEIA's live guidance identifies a consular contact and says any airport-visa possibility must be confirmed with that embassy.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Kontakt mit der Botschaft in Brüssel aufgenommen werden.

sources.title: Sierra Leone
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs, Austria
sources.officialityEvidence: BMEIA maps Austrian travellers to a Berlin-mission or online route but does not establish the final issuance point.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Bei der Botschaft in Berlin oder online auf folgender Webseite.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa service
sources.publisher: Sierra Leone Immigration Department eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: Sierra Leone Immigration Department's live slid.gov.sl page links www.evisa.sl as its 'Official Portal.' That live service contains contradictory electronic-delivery and airport/border-issuance language, so it cannot normalize the Austrian route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.

sources.title: Palestine
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs, Austria
sources.officialityEvidence: BMEIA's current page records crossing and checkpoint controls rather than one Palestine-wide Austrian-passport visitor route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: unangekündigten Totalsperren von Checkpoints/ Einreisepunkten nach Israel

sources.title: Ukraine
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs, Austria
sources.officialityEvidence: BMEIA's current Ukraine page records the operational environment but does not restate a current ordinary Austrian-passport visitor exemption.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vor Reisen in die Ukraine wird gewarnt.
